title: Equipment

{{for|wearable equipment|Clothing}}
'''Equipment''' is a term used on the wiki (not in-game) for useful items in Stardew Valley. The player [[Crafting|crafts]] most types of equipment from raw materials according to recipes that the player learns, usually by advancing in [[Skills|skill]] levels. The player can purchase some equipment from vendors instead of crafting it. Some equipment must be earned by completing [[Quests|Special Orders]], or dropped by [[Monsters]].

Some equipment, like fishing tackle, is highly portable, while other types remain stationary when in use.
